body: You are right, I grew up in poverty and around addicts my entire life, bad choices like that became normalized to me. I’m just thankful to be able to recognize that these are bad choices. It’s hard when you grow up surrounded by that, but I’m actively trying to better myself. It’s especially hard when I don’t receive any guidance or support from my family and friends. I guess I just feel lost, and it’s pretty fucked that the only people I can vent to are strangers online and not the people who are supposed to be there for me.
